subject: MAP: Cost gating & batch/caching acceptance for HelixMed pilot
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@helixmed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — cost gates + batching/caching acceptance (HelixMed pilot)

Hi Sylvia —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our MAP kickoff, I attached an updated mutual action plan (helix-pilot-map-v2.xlsx) and a quick CSV with our initial batching simulation outputs. Before we lock the pilot SOW and timeline, Procurement asked for explicit acceptance criteria on the unit economics side so their finance lead can sign off. Can you confirm the traffic profile below and the economic gates we should put in the MAP?

Target pilot profile (please confirm):
- Peak concurrent users: 12–18 sessions
- Avg requests/session: 9 prompts (mix of short prompts and 1 long summarization)
- Avg prompt length: 60 tokens in / 160 tokens out
- 7-day rolling peak token QPS target: 450 tokens/sec

Proposed cost acceptance gates (our suggested wording for the MAP):
- Token cost target: <= $0.0019 per 1k prompt tokens (model variant A)
- Batching: end-to-end P95 latency must remain <= 420ms with batching enabled (batch size up to 16)
- Caching: prefix caching to apply for repeated patient-context prompts; expected >20% token savings for templated requests

Ask: please confirm these numbers or send edits. If Procurement prefers, we can translate these into a simple tokens-per-dollar table for the MAP. Once we align we’ll update the MAP and loop in Legal for the SOW.

Attachments: helix-pilot-map-v2.xlsx (MAP draft), batching-sim-results-10-18.csv (sim outputs)

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@helixmed.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixMed Procurement <procurement@helixmed.com>
Date: 2028-10-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — cost gates + batching/caching acceptance (HelixMed pilot)

Camila —

Appreciate the clear next steps and the draft MAP. Quick replies inline:

- Traffic: those session numbers look right for our pilot cohort (we'll aim to seed with 150 users, expected ramp to 300 by week 3).
- Token assumptions: can you provide the tokens-per-dollar table mentioned? Finance needs that explicitly for their model.
- Batching / latency: procurement is OK with batching, but they want a P95 target that reflects real UI responsiveness. Can we change the MAP wording to: P95 end-to-end <= 450ms with batching enabled (max batch size 12), and a fallback SLO of P95 <= 700ms when batching deferred.
- Caching: confirmed — we run a fair amount of templated prompts and expect caching to hit. Please add a short acceptance clause: “If prefix caching yields <15% token savings over a week of production traffic, Redwood to propose optimization plan or model variant change.”

I've attached our SOC checklist excerpt for evidence (soc2-evidence-summary.pdf). Procurement may ask for a brief note on data retention to be included in the MAP appendix.

If you can send the tokens/$ table today we should be able to get Procurement to sign the MAP by Friday.

Best,
Sylvia Kim
Director, Digital Experience | HelixMed
Sylvia.Kim@helixmed.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — cost gates + batching/caching acceptance (internal)

Internal calc note —

I ran a quick tokens-per-dollar table using the sim outputs Camila attached. Assumptions: model variant A (quantized), infra mix: g4+ + caching enabled, average prompt/out tokens as Camila listed. Summary: 

- Base token cost (inference) estimate: $0.0024 per 1k tokens (without caching, no batching benefits)
- Effective token cost with 22% prefix caching and batching (avg batch size ~9): ~$0.0017 per 1k tokens

Recommendation for MAP wording to keep Procurement comfortable and leave room: propose a tokens-per-dollar schedule in the MAP with thresholds and an adjustment clause:
1) Expected: $0.0017 per 1k tokens (operationally measured week 2 average)
2) Gate: if week-2 measured cost > $0.0022 per 1k tokens, either Redwood provides optimization (batching tweak / quant profile) or Helix may pause the pilot with 7-day remediation

Tessa/Vivek — any red flags on this? Also Marcus — we should keep the batch size allowed in the MAP to 12 (per Sylvia) but call out that Redwood may dynamically size batches for latency-sensitive routes.

- Marcus
Engineering PM, Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Kim <sylvia.kim@helixmed.com>
Cc: HelixMed Procurement <procurement@helixmed.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-22T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — cost gates + batching/caching acceptance (HelixMed pilot)

Sylvia —

Thanks for the quick review and the SOC excerpt. Per internal calc (attached we used in the MAP), we’re happy to propose the tokens-per-dollar schedule below to include in the MAP appendix. This will give Procurement the explicit mapping they asked for and a clear gate.

Tokens-per-dollar schedule (append to MAP):
- Expected operational: $0.0017 per 1k tokens (measured over week 2; assumes 20–25% caching savings + batching avg size 9)
- Acceptable gate: <= $0.0022 per 1k tokens (week-2 measured). If exceeded, Redwood to provide optimization plan within 5 business days.
- Latency SLOs: P95 <= 450ms with batching (max batch size 12); fallback P95 <= 700ms if batching skipped for specific latency-sensitive routes.
- Caching clause: If prefix caching produces <15% token savings over a 7-day window, Redwood will propose a mitigation plan (config, prompt templates, or model variant change).

Next steps:
1) Sylvia / Procurement — please confirm you accept the tokens/$ schedule and the gating language above.
2) On sign, we’ll update helix-pilot-map-v2.xlsx and return an SOW for Legal review.
